title: Company overview
text: DarGlobal PLC is an international real estate developer focused on exclusive luxury developments in major cosmopolitan cities, for global buyers seeking investments, second homes and luxury living. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: DAR) since 2023 and says it builds on three decades of development experience. Total Gross Development Value (GDV) is stated as USD 23 billion. Founder and CEO: Ziad El Chaar, who oversaw the 2023 listing. DarGlobal was originally set up (2017) to house and develop the international assets of Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development, a leading Saudi developer.

title: Footprint and offices
text: The investor page gives the footprint as 13 cities across 8 countries (another section says 14 cities across 9 countries). Countries named: United Kingdom, Spain, Greece, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Oman, United States, Qatar. Sales and customer service offices: New York, London, Marbella, Athens, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Muscat and Doha. DarGlobal is also developing luxury hotels in Dubai, Muscat, Riyadh and Jeddah.

title: Brand partners
text: DarGlobal has partnered with over 11 luxury brands: Trump Organization, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, ELIE SAAB, Marriott Residences, Missoni, Mouawad, Fendi, Pagani Automobili, Paramount and W Hotels. Examples: Tierra Viva in Spain (53 villas, inspired by Lamborghini design), The Astera in Ras Al Khaimah (interiors by Aston Martin), Urban Oasis Tower in Dubai (interiors by Missoni), Neptune in Riyadh (interiors by Mouawad), Marriott Residences at AIDA in Oman.

title: Trump Tower Jeddah
text: Trump Tower Jeddah is a 47-floor seafront residential tower on the Jeddah Corniche, Saudi Arabia, with direct Red Sea views. Units: 1, 2, 3 and 4-bedroom apartments and 3 and 4-bedroom penthouses, 70 to 365 sqm. Completion scheduled December 2029. Amenities: Trump Private Club (Saudi Arabia's first members-only Trump Club), 24/7 concierge, meeting rooms, cigar lounge, fine dining, pool and kids' pool, jacuzzi, gym and yoga zone. Access to the marina, the Formula 1 street circuit and the King Fahd Fountain. The page lists no unit prices or payment plans; buyers are directed to the sales team. Premium Saudi residency is linked to an investment of SAR 4 million. Disclaimer on the page: the owner/developer is DarGlobal Holdings Real Estate, which uses the Trump name under license; The Trump Organization is not the owner, developer or seller.

title: Trump Tower Jeddah launch and construction
text: Trump Tower Jeddah was launched on 15 December 2024 as a SAR 2 billion (about USD 531 million) project in partnership with the Trump Organization. DarGlobal awarded the enabling works contract to Specialized Italian Foundation Co. (SIFCO); Arabian Construction Company (ACC) is named for main works.

title: Trump-branded portfolio and timeline
text: Trump-branded projects: The Trump Penthouses and Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai (80 floors, with a members-only club; launched April 2025); Trump Tower Jeddah (SAR 2bn, 47 floors); Trump Plaza Jeddah (over USD 1 billion, within the Amaya development on King Abdulaziz Road, launched January 2026); in Muscat, Oman under AIDA: Trump International Hotel (USD 500 million, 140 keys, 5-star, opening scheduled December 2028), Trump Cliff Villas and Trump Golf Villas; in Doha, Trump International Golf Club and beachfront villas in Simaisima with Qatari Diar. Timeline: Nov 2022 agreement signed in New York for AIDA; Mar 2023 AIDA sales launched; Jun 2024 Trump International Oman announced; Dec 2024 Trump Tower Jeddah launched.

title: AIDA, Muscat Oman
text: AIDA is a hilltop mixed-use development in Muscat, Oman near Downtown Muscat, a joint venture with Omran Group (Oman's tourism development arm). It has private beach access, an 18-hole golf course, a members-only club, the Cliff Hanging Night Club, hanging suites and villas, plus Marriott Residences and the Trump International Hotel. Phase one due 2027. Elevation is quoted variously as over 100 m to over 130 m above sea level.

title: Amaya, Rayana and other Saudi projects
text: Amaya is a 1 million sqm integrated urban community in Jeddah (described as Jeddah's 'Beverly Hills') that hosts Trump Plaza Jeddah; Al Dahlawi Company for Contracting was appointed for main works. Rayana is a master community in Wadi Safar, Diriyah, Riyadh, with a SAR 338 million infrastructure contract (Compass and Bin Omairah). Neptune in Riyadh has interiors by Mouawad. In August 2025 DarGlobal secured development rights for an integrated Riyadh scheme valued at about USD 2.8 billion, and on 11 Aug 2025 signed a joint development agreement for a mixed-use Jeddah project with GDV of about USD 1.9 billion.

title: Other international projects
text: Tierra Viva (Costa del Sol, Spain): 53 villas inspired by Lamborghini; first project in continental Europe. Les Vagues (Qatar), L'Horizon (Doha, Qatar) and the Simaisima community in Doha. Construction on Tierra Viva, AIDA and Les Vagues started in December 2023. In 2024 DarGlobal launched ten projects worth over USD 1.9 billion across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Oman and Spain, and signalled expansion into the US in 2025.

title: Financial results H1 2025
text: For the six months to 30 June 2025: EBITDA US$26.8 million (HY2024: loss of US$8.3m); profit US$12.2 million (HY2024: loss of US$12.8m); GDV of the project portfolio US$7.7 billion at 30 June 2025 (source: HY 2025 results RNS).

title: Partnership with Wasalt
text: On 16 April 2025 (Riyadh) DarGlobal announced a partnership with Wasalt to list Trump Tower Jeddah on Wasalt.sa and its iOS and Android apps. Wasalt has strong traction in Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam, helping DarGlobal target Saudi investors. CEO Ziad El Chaar said the project speaks to the evolving aspirations of the Saudi market. Both companies are linked to Dar Al Arkan.

title: Company overview
text: Wasalt is a Saudi Arabian AI-powered real estate platform (website and mobile app) for residential and commercial property: verified properties, projects, masterplans, online auctions and daily rentals. Every listing is verified by REGA (the Real Estate General Authority). It is a joint venture between Dar Al Arkan (27+ years of experience) and Quara Holding (technology startup incubator). Operated by Wasalt Real Estate Services Company; commercial registration 1010635634, Riyadh. Phone 8001233227. Apps on Apple App Store and Google Play.

title: Listings and search
text: Listing categories: residential for sale (houses, villas, plots), residential for rent (apartments, villas), commercial for sale (shops, offices, plots), commercial for rent (shops, offices). Search filters: property type, number of rooms, budget/price range, location, furnished or unfurnished. Sections: Buy, Rent, Projects, Daily Rentals and Barter. Users can list their own property for sale or rent in a few clicks, and brokers can call buyers who share requirements.

title: AI features and PropGenius
text: Wasalt partners with propgenius.ai. The PropGenius AI suite writes property descriptions in several languages, creates trend-based social media posts, gives real-time property valuations and ROI predictions, and helps attract and convert qualified leads. AI price prediction uses market trends.

title: Auctions
text: Wasalt is licensed by Infath (the Entrustment and Liquidation Center) to organise and manage electronic and hybrid real estate auctions. Auctions are timed; users can list properties for auction or bid. Wasalt also provides financial mediation at auctions.

title: Matchmaker
text: Matchmaker: the user fills in a questionnaire about their requirements and a broker is assigned to contact them directly. Matchmaker Packages were launched as a product.

title: Wasalt Business (brokers)
text: Wasalt Business is an all-in-one CRM for brokers to manage tasks, listings, leads and teams; it was launched as the first real estate app of its kind in Saudi Arabia and has passed 15,000 registered brokers.

title: Daily rentals
text: Wasalt Daily Rentals lets hosts list furnished apartments, villas, chalets and similar short-stay accommodation via Wasalt Business: sign up, add property details, set availability, publish. A Ministry of Tourism license is mandatory to list a daily rental (platform license #73106008). Prices are set by the host; payouts are processed weekly, every Tuesday, for check-ins of the previous week. Low commission advertised. Example nightly prices seen on the site range roughly from SAR 130 to SAR 1,100 for apartments in Jeddah, Riyadh and Dammam.

title: History and milestones
text: Wasalt launched in January 2022. Milestones: Wasalt Auction launch, Infath license, Wasalt Business launch, Matchmaker Packages, REGA license as a real estate portal, 15k+ brokers, PropGenius AI; surpassed 250,000 registered users in March 2024. By January 2025 it reported more than 750,000 registered users and 100,000 monthly leads, with an expected five-fold revenue increase from 2025 to 2028. Chairman of Wasalt: Ziad El Chaar (also CEO of DarGlobal).

title: Services (brokerage)
text: Services: residential and commercial brokerage; expert mediation for buying or leasing approved properties (approved only after quality control, verification and pricing review against market value); property management and maintenance; financial mediation at auctions; digital tools for property visits and transactions; several mortgage provider options through loan partners; access to property specialists.

title: DarGlobal and Wasalt relationship
text: DarGlobal and Wasalt are separate companies connected through Dar Al Arkan: DarGlobal was formed to house Dar Al Arkan's international assets, and Wasalt is a Dar Al Arkan / Quara Holding joint venture. Ziad El Chaar leads DarGlobal as CEO and is Chairman of Wasalt. In April 2025 they partnered to market Trump Tower Jeddah on Wasalt.
